entities.summary: Lidiya Loginova is a Russian former volleyball player. Born in Kazan, the then capital of the Tatar Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic in the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic, she competed for the Soviet Union at the 1980 Summer Olympics in Moscow, Soviet Union and won a gold medal.
